defects.name: hatchback
defects.description: Repeated dark triangular teeth cut across the upper windscreen; the same strip breaks the top-view window boundary.

defects.name: estate
defects.description: Repeated triangular windscreen artifacts interrupt the otherwise continuous glass pane.

defects.name: suv
defects.description: Upper windscreen has a repeated jagged row of solid triangles, also apparent from above.

defects.name: pickup
defects.description: Windscreen edge has several protruding triangular wedges that overlap the glass.

defects.name: panel_van
defects.description: The front glazing is interrupted by a broad body-coloured band and an angular gap at its lower boundary.

defects.name: motorcycle
defects.description: Several live lamp/indicator rectangles float beside the motorcycle, clear of the frame and handlebar.

defects.name: city_bus
defects.description: Camera on declared forward +X sees the bus rear (red tail lights and rear grille); the opposite end has its windshield and destination display. Model nose opposes the production heading.

defects.name: e_scooter_grab3d
defects.description: The live front light is a detached white block beside the handlebar/stem.

defects.name: bicycle
defects.description: Front and rear live lamps float beyond the bicycle frame rather than attaching to handlebar/saddle geometry.

defects.name: mountain_bike
defects.description: Live lamp rectangles float away from the mountain-bike model.

defects.name: train_coach
defects.description: A roof vent is visibly suspended above the coach roof, with a background-coloured gap beneath it.

defects.name: motorcycle with rider
defects.description: Detached live lamp/indicator pieces remain visible around the ridden motorcycle.

defects.name: bicycle with rider
defects.description: Live front/rear lamps float away from the ridden bicycle.

defects.name: e_scooter with rider
defects.description: Live front lamp floats in front of the ridden scooter stem.

defects.name: clothing/body variant 4
defects.description: Reflective chest strips stand clear of the curved jacket front; the top view exposes the separation.

defects.name: fox
defects.description: The fox is side-on when the camera is on its declared +X forward axis; the head faces a lateral axis. Other imported animals are front-on under the same camera convention.

defects.name: felled tree
defects.description: The felled crown lies flat, but its trunk is an upright vertical sliver separated from the crown.

defects.name: power_tower
defects.description: Successive narrowing tower-leg sections are disconnected: each upper segment floats inward from the end of the segment below.

defects.name: level_crossing
defects.description: Crossbuck faces run parallel to the road/declared heading: approaching along X sees only their edges; side cameras see the full X marks.

defects.name: roller_coaster
defects.description: The roller-coaster loop does not meet in height at its seam; one endpoint is visibly higher, leaving an open gap in the track.

defects.name: carousel
defects.description: Carousel seats float around the central mast without poles, chains or a platform joining them to the ride.

defects.name: swing_carousel
defects.description: Swing-carousel seats are suspended in empty space without their hanging chains/rods.

defects.name: ferris_wheel
defects.description: The Ferris-wheel rim has no spokes or connection to the support apex, leaving the moving rim unsupported.

defects.name: caravan_with_car
defects.description: The caravan-with-car prop is one undifferentiated cuboid: the separately required towing car and caravan are absent.

defects.name: tent
defects.description: The tent is a rectangular solid with a flat roof and no recognizable sloped/domed fabric profile or entrance.

defects.name: bicycle_parking
defects.description: Bicycle parking is an opaque solid bar, without any rack loops/slots; bicycles cannot visually occupy the intended rack geometry.

defects.name: picnic_table
defects.description: Picnic-table prop is a solid block down to ground, without the tabletop/legs/seating silhouette present in the 2D renderer.

defects.name: swing
defects.description: Swing prop is a solid red cuboid with no frame opening, suspended seat or supports; its functional silhouette is absent.

defects.name: slide
defects.description: Slide prop is a solid cuboid with no sloped sliding surface or elevated access geometry.

defects.name: spring_rider
defects.description: Spring rider is a plain cuboid; seat and spring/ground attachment geometry are absent.

defects.name: climbing_frame
defects.description: Climbing frame is an opaque cuboid, with none of the open bar structure implied by its asset type.

defects.name: seesaw
defects.description: Seesaw prop has a flat ground-level box silhouette without a fulcrum or raised seesaw beam.
